name: tiska
description: Your professional memory: save what you choose to keep and recall it with sources.

interface.longDescription: Tiska keeps the knowledge you choose to send — decisions and their reasons, commitments, people and projects from meetings, documents and conversations — in a private brain that only you can access. Ask ChatGPT to save a decision or an action item, then recall it later: what was decided and why, who owns which action, what changed since last week. Every answer comes with the source and date of each piece of information, and when the brain does not know, it says so. You can correct mistakes in plain language and forget any record. Tiska requires a Tiska account.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about the Atlas project and why? Check Tiska.
Which open actions do I have this week in Tiska?

positive.prompt: What did we decide about Project Atlas and why? Check Tiska.
positive.expected_behavior: Both decisions with their reasons and dates, citing the meeting records. The Nov 17 launch date replaces Nov 3.

positive.prompt: Which open actions are there on Atlas in Tiska?
positive.expected_behavior: Maya Chen's pilot invitation e-mail, due Nov 10. Leo's audit is not listed (done).

positive.prompt: Save this to Tiska: "Priya approved an extra QA engineer for Atlas starting Nov 12."
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms it was saved; a follow-up question about Atlas staffing finds it within a few seconds.

positive.prompt: Who is Priya Raman, according to Tiska?
positive.expected_behavior: Northwind's CTO, related to Project Atlas, with the records that mention her.

positive.prompt: What changed in my Tiska brain this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the save test case. Lists recently processed records and entities, including the saved note. The seeded records appear only if they were added within the period asked.

negative.description: Not about the user's stored knowledge: ChatGPT answers without calling Tiska.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in São Paulo today?

negative.description: Tiska does not make bookings, purchases or actions in external services: no Tiska tool is called and the assistant says Tiska can't do this.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon for next Monday.

negative.description: Tiska has no tool that erases a whole brain: no deletion happens without a preview and the user's confirmation. The assistant explains that it can forget specific records or sources after confirmation, and that permanent erasure is done in the Tiska web app.

review.commerce_description: Tiska does not process payments or offer purchases inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: capture knowledge, recall it with sources, correct mistakes and forget records.

pt-BR.subtitle: Sua memória profissional
pt-BR.description: A Tiska guarda o conhecimento que você escolhe enviar (decisões e seus motivos, compromissos, pessoas e projetos de reuniões, documentos e conversas) em um brain privado que só você acessa. Peça ao ChatGPT para guardar uma decisão ou uma ação e consulte depois: o que foi decidido e por quê, quem cuida de cada ação, o que mudou desde a semana passada. Cada resposta traz a fonte e a data de cada informação e, quando o brain não sabe, ele diz que não sabe. Você corrige erros em linguagem natural e pode esquecer qualquer registro. É preciso ter uma conta na Tiska.
